name: Storage account
summary: Secure-by-default storage account for blobs, files, queues, tables and Data Lake, reachable only through private endpoints.
useWhen: You need blob, file, queue, table or Data Lake Gen2 storage
You need a private, Entra ID only storage account with soft delete enabled
avoidWhen: You need an internet-facing static website without a private endpoint (set publicNetworkAccess to Enabled deliberately)
You need shared-key or SAS-only access (shared keys are disabled)
